basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable backend services and microservices. Expertise in full software lifecycle ownership, operational excellence, and developing robust, data-intensive systems. Passionate about modernizing architectures, developer toolchains, and clean, testable code.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented Python-based event-driven microservices, optimizing data processing for 10M+ daily events, contributing to scalable backend services.
Standardized containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, enhancing reliability and accelerating deployment through automation.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, leading technical design reviews and establishing robust coding standards and comprehensive testing practices.
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, demonstrating commitment to developer efficiency and operational excellence.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, contributing to full-stack experiences and backend service development.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, ensuring seamless external platform connectivity and reliable data exchange.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising coverage from 60% to 92%, promoting clean, testable, and production-ready code.
